subject: Network Theory
questionText:
A 24V battery of internal resistance r = 4 is connected 
to a variable resistance R. The rate of heat dissipation 
in the resistor is maximum when the current drawn 
from the battery is I. Current drawn from the battery 
will be I/2 when R is equal to, 
 
(a) 8Ω 
(b) 12Ω 
 
(c) 16Ω 
(d) 20Ω
explanation: Practice Question from Network Theory DPP-14 (Thevenin theorem and MPTT).
